sentences.en: Spain is reeling under the onslaught of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 西班牙正遭受新冠病毒的猛烈袭击。

sentences.en: The defenders checked the onslaught by the attackers.
sentences.zh: 防守方成功阻止了进攻方的猛攻。

sentences.en: The flood of emails was an onslaught on our inbox.
sentences.zh: 邮件洪流对我们收件箱来说是一场猛攻。

senses.zh: 猛攻，攻击,突击,大量的倾泻
